title: Hobot Code RDK quantization report v1

artifact.description: Final deployed model path relative to the RDK board task workspace.

provenance.description: Provenance document path relative to the x86 task workspace.

x-provenanceDocument.reportPointer: report.json.provenance contains exactly path and sha256

delivery.booleanMeaning: Agent edits to the source graph, source weights, or training; pure PTQ and compiler-generated representations leave all three false.

steps: Copy and digest the final model, source model, conversion YAML, and conversion log at four distinct board-relative paths.
Write provenance.json with those three provenance paths and compute its digest after the final write.
Write report.json last with the board artifact and x86 provenance pointer.
After any rewrite, recompute every affected digest before completion.
